checks.name: A1 H4 = r^4 P4(z/r) is harmonic (a valid source-free ambient)
checks.why: deepseek's l = 4 construction; harmonicity makes it a valid environment everywhere in the ball

checks.name: A2 all derivatives of H4 through order 3 vanish at the argument origin
checks.detail: vanishing: True (H4 is pure quartic -- no terms of degree < 4)
checks.why: this is WHY the 2-jet of g at P is untouched: the (n+1)-jet of Phi is the n-jet of g, and an l-harmonic centered at P perturbs the n-jet of g only when l <= n+1; l = 4 > 3 = safe -- the order trap, dodged

checks.name: A3 the analytic gradient of H4 matches sympy
C1 Pair 1 shared jets at P: |g| 0.00e+00, |J| 0.00e+00, |T| 0.00e+00 (exact by A2)
checks.detail: the H4 ambient contributes NOTHING to the 0/1/2-jet of g at P
checks.why: jet equality is EXACT (symbolic, A2) -- the numerical FD corroboration sits at FD precision and is not the primary evidence

checks.name: C2 every 2-jet invariant at P is IDENTICAL on the pair (max rel dev 0.00e+00)
checks.why: identical invariants + differing (Gamma, eta) => NO function of the 2-jet reproduces the framework's variables -- the obstruction, by counterexample

checks.name: C3 Pair 1 (Gamma, eta) DIFFER while the 2-jet is identical
checks.why: the pre-registered criterion (grok): jet equality < 1e-12 AND the separation > 1e3 x the quadrature floor -- the 10x bar was the wrong theorem and could false-kill a true lemma; do not patch amplitudes to chase it

checks.name: D1 the l >= 2 harmonics centered at B are harmonic with zero value and gradient at B
checks.why: so eta = |g_env(B)|/a0 = alpha/a0 is IDENTICAL across any two such ambients -- the amplitude channel is pinned; only the SHAPE channel can move

checks.name: D2 PAIR 2: |g(P)| matched to 0.00e+00, eta matched to 0.00e+00, Gamma moves 0.9x
checks.why: equal |g(P)| + equal eta + differing Gamma: mu(|g|) and every function of |g| are DEAD -- the scalar escape is closed separately from the 2-jet kill

checks.name: E1[HINGE-MUTANT] the local trigger mu(|g_N(P)|) separates the pair by 0.00e+00 -- CANNOT distinguish the configurations
checks.detail: |g_N(P)| identical across the pair (the 2-jet is shared): the local trigger is blind to exactly what the sphere functionals see
checks.why: FAIL IS THE FINDING: the mutant (a local mu(|g|) trigger) cannot carry the obstruction -- the gate flips
